title: What Does Merck (MRK) Mean For EU Bladder Cancer Treatment After CHMP Support?
summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) received a positive opinion from the EMA’s CHMP for KEYTRUDA plus Padcev in muscle-invasive bladder cancer. The CHMP backed the combination as perioperative therapy for adults with resectable muscle-invasive bladder cancer in the European Union. If endorsed by the European Commission, the regimen would be the first PD-1 inhibitor plus antibody-drug conjugate option for this setting in Europe. The CHMP verdict on KEYTRUDA plus Padcev is only one piece of the wider Merck story...

title: Is Johnson & Johnson Stock Expensive, Or Is STELARA Hiding The Real Price?
summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) stock has returned about 57% over the past year, against about 17% for the S&P 500. On the earnings it has already banked, that price looks expensive.
